question: Which treaty, signed in 1748, ended the War of the Austrian Succession in Europe and forced the French to return Madras to the British in exchange for Louisbourg in North America?
explanation: The Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle (1748) brought an end to the War of the Austrian Succession. In terms of this treaty, Madras, which had been captured by Dupleix, was restored to the British in exchange for the French getting back Louisbourg (in Nova Scotia, North America).

question: Which French diplomat and commander was famously stationed at the court of the Nizam of Hyderabad to safeguard French political and territorial interests?
explanation: Marquis de Bussy-Castelnau (commonly known as Bussy) was the French diplomat and military commander who resided at the court of the Nizam of Hyderabad, maintaining French influence there from 1751 to 1758.
